svg.text: Library returns to the villa; Cottage 01 is entirely private and extends to the right edge of the service building.
Cottage: 44 × 28 studs. Both right-hand exterior walls align at x = 126; roof eaves also align.
Blue routes: public access. Brown route: private cottage access. Green wall gaps: doors. Blue inserts: windows.
The cottage foyer and private garden remain. The shared promenade reaches services without crossing either.
Pool deck: 7 studs clear at both sides; 9.5 behind and 11 in front, between coping and guards.
Loungers occupy the front band; a 4.5-stud strip between coping and loungers stays clear.
Architectural proxy plan · not LEGO connection verification or real-building certification
